MathJax 4.1.3 and @mathjax/mathjax-newcm-font 4.1.3
Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/mathjax/-/mathjax-4.1.3.tgz
Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/@mathjax/mathjax-newcm-font/-/mathjax-newcm-font-4.1.3.tgz
Both npm packages declare Apache-2.0; license text is included.
MathJax is distributed with all runtime components, including speech data.
The font package includes the CHTML entry, dynamic extensions and WOFF2 files.
Server-side source, examples and SVG-only font assets are omitted.
